children.name: alias
children.description: Property name to use as entrypoint to the service

children.name: fieldAlias
children.description: alias for deeper nested relationships (e.g. { 'price': 'prices.calculated\_price\_set.amount' })

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: schema
children.description: GraphQL schema for the all module's available entities and fields

children.name: isLink
children.description: If the module is a link module

children.name: linkableKeys
children.description: Keys that can be used to link to other modules. e.g { product\_id: "Product" } "Product" being the entity it refers to

children.name: isReadOnlyLink
children.description: If true it expands a RemoteQuery property but doesn't create a pivot table

children.name: extraDataFields
children.description:
Fields that will be part of the link record aside from the primary keys that can be updated
If not explicitly defined, this array will be populated by databaseConfig.extraFields

children.name: databaseClientUrl
children.description: Resolved database client URL for this module. This is used to determine if we can do in-DB cross module filtering

children.name: __passSharedContainer
children.description: only used in exceptional cases - relying on the shared contrainer breaks encapsulation

children.name: timeout
children.description: The global timeout for the entire transaction workflow (in seconds).

children.name: store
children.description:
If true, the state of the transaction will be persisted.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/store-executions).

children.name: retentionTime
children.description:
The number of seconds that the workflow execution should be stored in the database.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/store-executions).

children.name: storeExecution
children.description: If true, the execution details of each step will be stored.

children.name: idempotent
children.description: If true, the workflow will use the transaction ID as the key to ensure only-once execution

children.name: schedule
children.description:
Defines the workflow as a scheduled workflow that executes based on the cron configuration passed.
The value can either by a cron expression string, or an object that also allows to define the concurrency behavior.

children.name: concurrency
children.description:
Setting whether to allow concurrent executions (eg. if the previous execution is still running, should the new one be allowed to run or not)
By default concurrent executions are not allowed.

children.name: numberOfExecutions
children.description: Optionally limit the number of executions for the scheduled workflow. If not set, the workflow will run indefinitely.

children.name: steps
children.description: Defines the structure and behavior of a single step within a transaction workflow.

children.name: next
children.description: Defines the next step(s) to execute after this step. Can be a single step or an array of steps.

children.name: uuid
children.description:
A unique identifier for the transaction step.
This is set automatically when declaring a workflow with "createWorkflow"

children.name: action
children.description:
Specifies the action to be performed in this step.
"name" is an alias for action when creating a workflow with "createWorkflow".

children.name: continueOnPermanentFailure
children.description:
Indicates whether the workflow should continue even if there is a permanent failure in this step.
In case it is set to true, the current step will be marked as TransactionStepState.PERMANENT\_FAILURE and the next steps will be executed.

children.name: skipOnPermanentFailure
children.description:
Indicates whether the workflow should skip all subsequent steps in case of a permanent failure in this step.
In case it is set to true, the next steps of the workflow will not be executed and their status will be marked as TransactionStepState.SKIPPED\_FAILURE.
In case it is a string, the next steps until the step name provided will be skipped and the workflow will be resumed from the step provided.

children.name: noCompensation
children.description: If true, no compensation action will be triggered for this step in case of a failure.

children.name: maxRetries
children.description:
The maximum number of times this step should be retried in case of temporary failures.
The default is 0 (no retries).

children.name: autoRetry
children.description:
If true, the step will be retried automatically in case of a temporary failure.
The default is true.

children.name: retryInterval
children.description:
The interval (in seconds) between retry attempts after a temporary failure.
The default is to retry immediately.

children.name: retryIntervalAwaiting
children.description: The interval (in seconds) to retry a step even if its status is "TransactionStepStatus.WAITING".

children.name: maxAwaitingRetries
children.description: The maximum number of times to retry a step even if its status is "TransactionStepStatus.WAITING".

children.name: timeout
children.description:
The maximum amount of time (in seconds) to wait for this step to complete.
This is NOT an execution timeout, the step will always be executed and wait for its response.
If the response is not received within the timeout set, it will be marked as "TransactionStepStatus.TIMEOUT" and the workflow will be reverted as soon as it receives the response.

children.name: async
children.description:
If true, the step is executed asynchronously. This means that the workflow will not wait for the response of this step.
Async steps require to have their responses set using "setStepSuccess" or "setStepFailure", unless it is combined with "backgroundExecution: true".
If combined with a timeout, and any response is not set within that interval, the step will be marked as "TransactionStepStatus.TIMEOUT" and the workflow will be reverted immediately.

children.name: nested
children.description: It flags where the step contains a sub transaction inside itself.

children.name: backgroundExecution
children.description:
It applies to "async" steps only, allowing them to run in the background and automatically complete without external intervention.
It is ideal for time-consuming tasks that will be complete after the execution, contrasting with standard "async" operations that require a response to be set in a later stage.

children.name: compensateAsync
children.description: If true, the compensation function for this step is executed asynchronously. Which means, the response has to be set using "setStepSuccess" or "setStepFailure".

children.name: noWait
children.description: If true, the workflow will not wait for their sibling steps to complete before moving to the next step.

children.name: saveResponse
children.description:
If true, the response of this step will be stored.
Default is true.

children.name: store
children.description: Whether we need to store checkpoint at this step.

types.name: medusaContext
types.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: runId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current run.

children.name: messageAggregator
children.description: An instance of a message aggregator, which is used to aggregate messages to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: requestId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current request.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: preventReleaseEvents
children.description: preventReleaseEvents

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.name: cancelingFromParentStep
children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

children.name: orchestrator
children.description:
TransactionOrchestrator is responsible for managing and executing distributed transactions.
It is based on a single transaction definition, which is used to execute all the transaction steps

children.description: Trace workflow transaction for instrumentation

children.description: Trace workflow steps for instrumentation

children.description: Finalize the transaction when all steps are complete
